about: Hand-labelled attachment check for the knowledge map: cards, questions and practice problems of the demo account (studyflow.demo@gmail.com), each read against the key points of its own document and given the one it is about, or null when none fits. Concept keys are "<source id>:<key point index>" as dumped by manage.py dump_concept_items. Labelled by one person.
